replaces.change: The bundled vegetarian ramen boiled noodles with their seasoning sachet and dressed the bowl with 50 g soy sauce. This version discards the sachet entirely and builds broth from shiitake, garlic, ginger, 1.5 tbsp soy and sesame oil - so the sodium number is fully mapped with no stock line at all. Instant noodles replaced by dried egg noodles measured dry. The egg is boiled to 160°F (71°C) - just-set yolk; pasteurized eggs if you want it looser.

qty.note: half of a standard 250 g package; cook yields roughly triple this weight
in place of the discarded seasoning sachet and the bundled 50 g soy line

steps.text: Bring 700 ml water to a boil in a saucepan with the shiitake mushrooms, garlic, ginger coins and half the green onions. Drop to a bare simmer for 8 minutes so the shiitake gives the water a proper broth.

While the broth simmers, boil the eggs in a separate small pot for 8 minutes exactly, then lift them into ice water. Check one with a thermometer: the yolk must read 160°F (71°C) - just set, still fudgy. Use pasteurized eggs if you want it looser than that.

safety.source: USDA FSIS safe minimum internal temperature table

steps.text: Peel the cooled eggs and halve them. Fish the ginger coins out of the broth - they gave their flavour and would go stringy.
Drop the noodles into the broth and cook for 4 minutes, or per the pack timing, stirring once so they do not weld together.
Add the spinach for the last minute so it wilts but keeps its colour, then season the broth with the soy sauce - pour it around the edge, not onto the noodles, so it mixes evenly.
Divide noodles and greens between deep bowls and ladle the broth over. Top with the egg halves, the rest of the green onions, and a few drops of sesame oil and grind of black pepper each.

nutrition_per_serving.basis: USDA FoodData Central values committed in apps/ios/Resources/usda_ingredient_catalog.sqlite (matched fdc_id per ingredient in tables/nutrition-map.json), plus the app's shipped core-ingredient table (data.json) for items without an fdc_id; scaled by evidenced gram quantities
